data.name: Naziih
data.gender_notes: Naziih is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic verb ‘nazaha’, meaning to help or aid. In Islamic history, Naziih is a name given to individuals who provide aid and assistance to others. The name Naziih carries the meaning “Helping, Aiding, Assisting” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Naziih usually hope their child will grow to embody helping, aiding, assisting and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To serve and assist others in their spiritual journey towards Allah.
data.etymology: Naziih belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Helping, Aiding, Assisting.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Naziih total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_urdu.name: نظيف
in_urdu.long_meaning: نظيف کا مطلب ہے پاک و صاف لوگ، اور یہ عربی جڑ ن ز ح سے ماخوذ ہے جو قرآن پاک میں پاکیزگی اور برکت کے سیاق و سباق میں آتا ہے، اور یہ مسلمانوں کی ثقافت میں نیک و صالح لوگوں کی وضاحت کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے

in_english.name: Naziih
in_english.long_meaning: Naziih is an Arabic name meaning pure and strong-willed person, derived from the Arabic root ن ز ح which appears in the Quran in the context of purity and blessing, and is used in Islamic culture to describe righteous and virtuous individuals

data.cultural_impact: The name Naziih holds significant cultural importance in Islamic communities as it highlights the virtues of helping and aiding others. It is a reminder of the importance of kindness, generosity, and compassion in everyday life. Individuals with the name Naziih are expected to embody this quality and make positive contributions to their communities by providing support and assistance where needed.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, the name Naziih holds deeper significance as it reflects the worship of Allah through serving and aiding others. Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is reported to have said, "Whoever helps his brother, Allah will help him in this world and in the Hereafter." (Sunan At-Tirmidhī 2398). By embodying the name's meaning and providing aid and assistance to those in need, one is not only contributing to their communities but also increasing their own spiritual growth and draws closer to Allah.
